fixed.how: Root cause: GET /sessions/:id and the Sessions list read the daemon's stillBlocked (views.ts), which never read handoff.review_waits. countsOf/countsWords counted every paused task as paused. The runner's session.ended payload carried one paused count. Fix: stop-words.ts reviewWaitIds reads handoff.review_waits. For an older row it reads the outcome's paused tasks marked reviewWaits (L4-money-111). stillBlocked, blockedOfHandoff and stillWaitsText now count those tasks apart. countsOf adds tasks.reviewWaits; it is optional in the API and absent when none. countsWords says '1 review waits for room'. session.ended carries reviewWaits, so event-lines' end line says it (one runner.ts data line). A session that did only that task has the gist '"X" is done; its review waits for room in its budget of CHF 0.01.'. The composed case checks the same words after a second compose on the same home.

fixed.how: Root cause: budgetStopTitle (the card title and the task reason), budgetPauseLabelOf (the row) and the outcome's `before` (the result, the session task rows, the Sessions row) said 'paused before ... ran out' only for a wrap-up. A hard stop under an outer limit always said 'paused at'. The session words also said 'Ended before ... ran out' when a call billed more than its check took the run past the limit. The stand-in does this: the real-daemon run spent CHF 0.07 of CHF 0.06. Fix: one rule, pausedBeforeLimit(card), in the leaf session/review-room-words.ts. It is true for a wrap-up, or for an outer limit (project budget, month cap, subscription share) whose card's spent_usd_micro is below cap_usd_micro. budgetStopTitle, budgetPauseLabelOf and the runner's outcome `before` (one data line) read it. The session words say 'Stopped at <limit>' only when the session's own spend reached the limit (outerLimitPassed in stop-words.ts). That covers stopWords, sessionStatusText/endedStatusText (badge, Sessions row, docs note), a limitPassed flag on session.ended (log end line) and the budget_stop notification title. The plan share's title uses "your subscription's share" to stay within 60 characters. Cards filed before keep their stored titles.

notes_for_other_areas: New helpers in session/review-room-words.ts (a leaf with no imports, so the UI's fake daemon reads it): outerLimitPausedWords(source), limitLeftAtStop(stop) and pausedBeforeLimit(card). New helpers in stop-words.ts: reviewWaitIds(handoff), reviewWaitsWords(n), outerLimitPassed({spentChfMicro, stopCapChfMicro}) and outerLimitPassedOfHandoff(handoff). sessionStatusText and endedStatusText take an optional limitPassed. stopWords takes an optional spentChfMicro.

API: ProjectSessionRowView.tasks gains an optional reviewWaits field (absent when none), and tasks.paused no longer counts those tasks. session.ended's payload gains reviewWaits, and paused excludes them; limitPassed is true only when the session spent all of the outer limit. The fake daemon's rows carry no reviewWaits, which the optional field allows.

Sentences, old -> new. Badge, row and end words: 'Ended: 1 paused' -> 'Ended: 1 review waits for room' (plural '2 reviews wait for room'). Counts: '1 done, 1 paused' -> '1 done, 1 review waits for room'. End line: 'Session over: 1 done, 1 paused. CHF 0.02.' -> 'Session over: 1 done, 1 review waits for room. CHF 0.02.'. Row with someone needed: '1 still needs you, 1 paused' + ', 1 review waits for room'. Gist of a session whose only task waits: '"X" paused at its budget of CHF 0.01.' -> '"X" is done; its review waits for room in its budget of CHF 0.01.' (two or more: '"A" and "B" are done; their reviews wait for room.').

Outer-limit pause words, old -> new, when some of the limit is left. Card title and task reason: '"X" paused at the project's budget of CHF 0.06' -> '"X" paused before the project's budget ran out' (also 'paused before this month's cap ran out' and "paused before your Claude subscription's share ran out"). Row label: "Paused at the project's budget" -> "Paused before the project's budget ran out" (also "Paused before this month's cap ran out"). Session task row, result and Sessions gist: 'paused at the project's budget of CHF 0.06' -> 'paused before the project's budget of CHF 0.06 ran out'. Two or more outer pauses: 'paused at a limit: they are ready again ...' -> 'paused before a limit ran out: ...'. budget_stop notification title: "<project>: stopped at the project's budget" -> "<project>: ended before the project's budget ran out" (plan share: "ended before your subscription's share ran out"). Start dialog: 'Nothing can run: "X" paused before the project's budget ran out; raise it in Settings.'. When the spend reached the limit: the old 'paused at ... of CHF ...' words, and "Stopped at the project's budget" with 'Stopped at the project's budget of CHF 0.06.' for the session.
UI: taskCapWords gives '<budget> budget' when nothing is spent ('CHF 0.01 budget'). The task drawer shows 'budget CHF 0.01' instead of 'spent CHF 0.00 of CHF 0.01 budget'.

Merge with w8-together: the conflicts are only in the appended blocks (real-daemon.test.ts, apps.md, runtime.md, user-guide.md); keep both sides. If w8-together's status board writes a paused task's card title or reason to GitHub, it now carries the new words. The words carry no CHF amount in the outer-limit title.

'A task with its own budget that spent nothing shows "CHF 0.01 budget" (L4i-left-64).'.
